description: Mapping of test batch card IDs to their original image files

notes.spike_wall: Orange rectangular wall with zigzag spiky edges and eyes on stalks - legendary card with Double Black Hole ability
notes.dirty_diaper: Yellow/brown diaper with brown dots - has Glitter Poo ability
notes.fierce_cow: Gray cow face with orange nostrils, angry expression with action lines - has Cow Patty Splat defense
notes.ice_cream_flinger: 5-scoop colorful ice cream cone (chocolate, blue, orange, green, pink) - has Laser Melt and Freeze Ray
notes.box: Simple orange spiky creature inside teal rectangular box - weakest card with Roll ability
notes.shofario: Brown shofar (ram's horn) with musical notes - legendary card with Summons Ghost Army ability
notes.the_scribbler: Abstract bird-like scribbles in teal/orange/purple extending outside box frame - has Outside the Lines ability
notes.wonka_wacka_doodle_monster: Abstract zigzag/swirl patterns in multiple colors - has Zigger Zagger Defeats and Doodling abilities
notes.robo_jolt: Robot with teal body, orange hands/feet, multiple orange eyes - has Robo-Voice and Robo-Claw abilities
notes.doublespike: Two dark spiky ball creatures connected by a line - has Black Hole ability
